# 幸運方塊世界附加包

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1327308441324097681?label=discord&color=blue&logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/5UdcDa5xNC)
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/lucky-blocks-world?label=modrinth&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/lucky-blocks-world)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/lullaby6/data-packs)](https://github.com/lullaby6/data-packs/blob/main/LICENSE)

<hr>

## 📖 說明

[Lucky Blocks](https://modrinth.com/datapack/ly-lucky-blocks) 附加包，在主世界中尋找隨機生成的幸運方塊！

<hr>

## ⚠️ 需求

您必須先安裝 [Lucky Blocks](https://modrinth.com/datapack/ly-lucky-blocks)。

<hr>

## ⌨️ 指令

尋找幸運方塊：

```mcfunction
/locate structure lucky_blocks_world:lucky_block
```

<hr>

## 🪪 授權條款

[AGPL-3.0-or-later](https://github.com/lullaby6/data-packs/blob/main/LICENSE)

<hr>

## 👾 錯誤與問題

請在 [Discord 伺服器](https://discord.gg/5UdcDa5xNC) 回報任何問題、錯誤或建議。
